prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: Aichemy V2 controlled food option comparison food-angle-eye; one single portrait 4:5 photorealistic food photograph.
Input images: Image 1 is the edit target and invariant baseline.
Primary request: Change only camera viewpoint to a clearly LOW EYE-LEVEL view with lens just above the plate rim, looking almost horizontally across it with only about 8 degrees of downward tilt. Emphasize the height and side profile of the same rice mound, egg and upright crackers; the plate appears as a shallow ellipse. Camera height must look obviously different from a three-quarter view. Keep the same plate and food in place, comparable dish width and full plate in frame, same white surface, gray backdrop and neutral soft light. Do not flatten or reduce the serving.
Subject invariants: Preserve this exact synthetic nasi goreng serving and its beige speckled ceramic plate, dark small sambal bowl at left, one sunny-side-up egg with orange yolk and crisp lacy edges over the same chicken fried rice, same visible rice grains, chicken pieces, scallion, red chili, cooked egg pieces and fried shallot already present. Keep the exact serving quantity, cucumber and tomato fan at rear left, pale crackers at rear right, and their relative arrangement. Do not invent ingredients, add garnish, restyle or redistribute the food, change the plate or bowl, or change the portion.
Scene invariants: retain the same smooth matte white horizontal tabletop, plain light warm-gray neutral backdrop, elevated three-quarter camera at about 40 degrees downward, exact plate size and position in frame, entire plate visible with small side margins, and broad soft neutral diffuse light from upper left, except the ONE variable explicitly requested above. Do not change any other variable.
Style/medium: realistic commercial food photography with natural texture and food color; preserve ceramic speckles, rice grain detail and appetizing crisp egg edge.
Constraints: single portrait 4:5 photo, no collage, no diagrams, no text, logo or watermark. No added ingredients, food on the plate, utensils, hands, containers or other props except the expressly requested external styling. External styling must remain outside the plate with visible separation; it conveys no ingredient or product claim.
reviewNotes: Inspected actual generated image. Food identity and neutral scene preserved, but camera remains too elevated for a clearly eye-level option. Rejected for final use; targeted lower-camera correction requested.
